scope: read-only native trace observability, not gameplay or win-rate evaluation

derived_replay.description: Rows 0-53 of final-room trace, local demo only; not a new game run

validation.overlay_visual: AppKit 410x490 point panel inspected in replay and live-follow modes; Jev 84% confidence, 86% selected candidate, separate Astra plan, no overlap after layout fix; stale trace marked waiting and victory shown explicitly

limitations: The game had returned to its main menu before final overlay inspection; a composited capture over the earlier victory screen was unavailable.
Actual click-through and stacking over an active fullscreen combat window were configured in AppKit but not independently exercised by a game input test.
The native overlay requires macOS and PyObjC; the localhost browser monitor remains the cross-platform fallback.
Jev confidence and probabilities are model outputs, not calibrated win probabilities.
decision: Open PR for user placement review; do not merge until fullscreen game overlay position/click-through is visually accepted or exercised.
